name: L5 frozen macaque-to-human representation pilot with forward whole-trial holdout
status: Locked before any H1 L5 score; H1 dataset and prior methods already examined, exploratory target assay
prior_information: M1 source and three new source sessions audited positive. Old H1 minival scores invalid for held-out claims because neural/target arrays copy calibration prefixes. All H1 calibration values and earlier F1b outcomes already viewed. V1 timescale/history and common ridge1 were selected previously on H1 development; shared by all matched feature banks. Encoder optimization/weights/checkpoint selection used M1 only.

data.selection: Exactly13 held-IN calibration files matching old13 H1 minival stems; no minival arrays used as query
data.outputs: All7 instructed open-loop velocity axes, not measured hand trajectories
data.recording_days: Six coded recording dates containing13 calibration sets
data.metric: Float64 variance-weighted R2 over all seven outputs and every eligible future query row; unweighted13-set average primary

support_and_query.trials: Use unique trial IDs containing eligible rows, in time order; H1 official trial_change indicates starts (TrialNum positive differences), do not shift flags
support_and_query.support: First k whole trials, k1 and3. All methods inspect the same eligible labels within those trials. Exact raw bins/trial IDs/hashes and actual eligible label counts saved.
support_and_query.query: Common across both k: ALL whole trials strictly after the first3 support trials, all eval_mask True rows, including zero-velocity rows. No overlap in trial IDs, bins or feature context.
support_and_query.features: Causal25tap frozen banks; trial/file reset. BaselineV1 finite240ms exponential plus lags0..4, coefficients/history preserved exactly; normalizations support-only std floor0.1.
support_and_query.primary_support_mode: ALL eligible rows in the first3 trials. This includes rest labels and prevents a moving-only training/rest-inclusive query mismatch. Whole-trial label costs reported, not just moving seconds.
support_and_query.secondary_support_mode: MOVING eligible rows only, abs target>=.001 on anyaxis, for every method at both k. This reconstructs old V1 fitting convention with disjoint queries. No choice of mode from outcomes.
support_and_query.calibration_cost: Support label inspection uses all eligible rows of k whole trials in both modes. Readout fitted rows differ between all/moving. Report labelled bins, nominal20ms time, trial recording span and earlier unlabelled context. No replay/gradient on target for this frozen pilot.

banks.trained: All18 real/synthetic/time_shift x linear/softplus x3 source fits, exact selected checkpoints; weights frozen under data/audit/wacv_l5_frozen_banks_20261011.json
banks.fixed: V1, sqrt-count V1, multiscale, three smooth random banks, initialsoftplus V1
banks.capacity: 25lag raw andsqrtcount, 4400dimensions versus880 in five-filterbanks; both ridge1 andsource-selected10, all reported; no target selection of which lambda

head.purpose: Same readout regularization for all matched banks so representation differences cannot be attributed to different source-selected head lambdas
head.intercept: Unpenalized support target mean, one pooled scale cancels algebraically
head.normalization: Support-only feature mean/std fixedfloor0.1; no query activity or labels in moments
head.solve: Mean-normalized primal or dual ridge in float64, exactly equivalent. Form weights before multiplying query features to avoid a large query-by-support matrix. Wide capacity heads may use Cholesky; verify against independent direct solve.
head.target_selection: No new target tuning, checkpoint selection, fine-tuning or calibrated bank learning. Shared human-derived preprocessing/lambda acknowledged, not a wholly source-only method design.

primary: k3, ALL-eligible support, LINEAR source bank; mean three source-fit scores within set, then unweightedmean13 sets. Not a prediction ensemble.
secondary: k1, moving-only support, softplus variant, perseed and perday scores; no replacement of primary
contrasts: real minus both lambda1/10 capacity models, unequal dimensions disclosed

intervals.clusters: Six coded recording days; resample days, retaining all sets in each sampledday, and compute weighted-by-set primary mean. Average source-fit scores within set BEFORE cluster resampling.
intervals.meaning: Descriptive conditional on one participant and source fits; already-seen target dataset, multiple contrasts exploratory. No population/species conservation or confirmatory significance claim.

failures: Record every failed set/bank/mode and reason; save partial predictions. No excluded file, fallback, seed replacement, variant/mode selection from outcomes.
preflight: Exact V1 features/predictions on same support/query rows
Primal/dual/Cholesky head equivalence including constant-support features
Whole-trial temporal disjointness and query history independent of support
Neuron permutation equivariance and query labels do not define support weights
Frozen source fit-file hashes and no target gradient updates
Synthetic source-calibration dry only, no H1 score before independent numerical/code checks
artifacts: data/wacv/xspecies_l5_human_forward: protocol/source hashes, every per-set raw prediction/bank/mode/budget, source/filter IDs, calibration/query row IDs, label costs, scores/per-axis errors and cluster contrasts, independent audit.
interpretation: A source-specific target benefit requires real beating matched synthetic training and a credible human-only/generic baseline under disjoint queries. Frozen pilot does not exhaust proper transfer strategies or replicate foundation models. Target-only learned filters, genuine target fine-tuning and local readout are separately registered follow-through, not retrospectively added to this primary.
